decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Block Plan, Site Location Plan, received 04/04/2014) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The use hereby permitted shall not be open to customers outside the following times 1100 hrs to 2300 hrs Monday to Sunday
Condition : 4 - Refuse generated by the use shall be stored entirely within the building and should not be placed on the adjoining highway.
Condition : 5 - No deliveries shall be taken at or despatched from the site outside the hours of 0700 and 1000 Mondays to Saturdays or for any time on Sundays and public holidays.
description: Variation of condition 3 (Hours) following permission 00610/107/P3 for Change of use from A1 (retail) to A3 (coffee shop/cafe) incorporating a new shop front and extract duct to rear dated 21.12.2006.
